figurative_meaning_en: To be affected by the influence of a malevolent deity in the form of wind
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছেলেটার বাতাস লেগেছে, তাই সে হঠাৎ অসুস্থ হয়ে পড়েছে।
বাইরে ঘুরতে গিয়ে বাতাস লেগে তার জ্বর হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy has been affected by the wind, so he suddenly fell ill.
After going out, he caught the wind and developed a fever.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali beliefs in supernatural afflictions often linked to sudden illnesses.
